name: bump patch
description: Release a patch version (0.0.X) when merged: bug fixes, docs, small changes

name: bump minor
description: Release a minor version (0.X.0) when merged: new features

name: bump major
description: Release a major version (X.0.0) when merged: breaking changes

name: no release
description: Merge without a release (CI, refactoring that changes nothing shipped)
